label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
Good evening, Mr Kehinde Ogunleye.

Thank you for calling me about my black Jansport bag and for keeping it safe. I’m grateful you didn’t just leave it or throw it away. It has my lab manual, dissecting kit, student ID, two textbooks, calculator and glasses inside, so getting it back is important to me.

I’m the first-year biology student who lost it on Friday evening, 6 November, in the Oshodi-to-Igando bus. I got down at Ikotun. My BIO 101 practical is on Wednesday, 11 November, at 10 a.m., and I need my dissecting kit and ID card to take part.

I understand you may have spent time and money trying to return the bag, and I’m happy to contribute ₦10,000 towards your transport and as a thank-you. I’m sorry, but I can’t afford ₦40,000; it’s more than I can manage, especially as a student. Please consider accepting the ₦10,000 so we can arrange to return the bag before Wednesday.

My roommate, Adaeze, can come with me, and we can meet during the day at a public place in Ikotun, such as the roundabout. Please let me know which day and time before Wednesday would work for you. I’d really appreciate us settling this respectfully and promptly.

Thank you again for keeping my things safe. Please reply when you can so we can agree on a time.
